name: Wonton Soup
subtitle: thin pastry dumplings in a clear peppery broth, Kolkata Chinatown

ingredients.note: or finely chopped mushroom and cabbage for a vegetarian version

prepNotes: The broth should be clear and taste of pepper and ginger. Cloudy broth means it boiled hard; keep it at a bare simmer.
Wrappers must be rolled genuinely thin. You should almost see the filling through them.

steps.text: Make a firm dough with the flour, egg and a little water. Rest 30 minutes, roll very thin and cut 8cm squares.
Mix the mince with half the spring onion, the ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce, half the pepper and salt.
Place a small spoonful on each square, wet the edges and pinch closed into a pouch.
steps.tip: Small. An overfilled wonton splits in the water.

steps.text: Bring the water to a bare simmer with the garlic, remaining soy sauce, pepper and oil. Season.
Slide the wontons in and poach 6 minutes until they float and the wrappers turn translucent.
steps.tip: A simmer, never a boil. A rolling boil tears them open.

steps.text: Ladle into bowls with the broth and finish with spring onion and coriander.

storage: The broth keeps 3 days refrigerated. Cook wontons fresh; poached ones swell and go pasty. Uncooked wontons freeze well for a month.
